name: QA graph interception
description: QA only (G-intercept through the graph, C4): intercepts Thread.send, archive and stop with ctx.graph.intercept and logs each call to <dataDir>/files/intercept.log. A send whose letters contain gintercept is refused; one with 'gwait N' is held N seconds before it goes on (the interceptor's deadline is 20 s); one with 'gchange' goes on with changed text. Archive is refused while <dataDir>/files/refuse-archive exists.
